followup_explanation:
This is a benign math/reasoning problem with no harm-adjacent, distasteful, or hostile content, so neither model's behavioral preferences create any concern. The decision comes down to raw capability.

Whimbrel-235B has clearly stronger benchmarks on reasoning-relevant metrics (MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 64.8 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.2 vs 81.4) — all well beyond run-to-run variance. A word problem requiring multi-step arithmetic reasoning benefits most from the model with higher quantitative reasoning capability, which is Whimbrel.

The request is also neutral-to-warm in tone and somewhat open-ended ("work through this"), which sits comfortably within Whimbrel's preferred task profile, so there's no downside on the preference dimensions either.
